advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.title: Maintenance Tech Sr.
advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.description: Founded in 1985, ATS is a company with a presence in the United States, Mexico and the United Kingdom. We are professionals in Industrial Maintenance and we make factories run better. Fundada en 1985, ATS es una empresa con presencia en los Estados Unidos, México y el Reino Unido. Somos profesionales en mantenimiento industrial y hacemos que las fábricas funcionen mejor. Principal Duties/Responsibilities: · Performs expert level break-fix & preventative maintenance. This includes but is not limited to: observing devises in operation to locate root cause of problem; dismantling devices to gain access to and remove defective parts; examining parts to detect imperfections; adjustment of functional parts of devices and control instruments; repair and/or replacement of defective parts; testing of device to observe performance; and performing tests for electrical circuitry and mechanical systems; reconditioning and repairing machine tools. · Identifies and sources parts, supplies and repair items as necessary. Performs evaluations of alternatives to improve cost and / or reliability of equipment. · Independently performs maintenance as per industry standards. · Works with Planner Scheduler to optimize preventative maintenance procedures. · May be required to setup and operate multiple machining operations including but not limited to: lathe, drill press, grinder, and other metalworking tools to make and repair parts. May perform welding tasks. · Complies with 5S and housekeeping standards. · Leads, drives and participates in CI activities--processes, results and cost savings using CI tools and methodology. · Provides assistance to lower level technicians and leadership to project teams. Performs expert functions as a part of training and development. · Troubleshoots and analyzes complex control systems to resolve in-depth software/ hardware and configuration problems. · Utilizes predictive maintenance technologies to collect equipment performance data. Observes trends and makes recommendations. · Updates records and reviews CMMS history and analyzes data. · Completes and conducts on-the-job training and technical self-study programs for career development. · Follows all safety related policies, rules, regulations, technical instructions and guidelines. Situational awareness and identify unsafe behaviors and conditions. Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, & Behaviors Required: · High School Graduate or equivalent (GED). · Associates degree with a Technical focus and 5 years of related experience in specific industry; or, 7 years of experience in specific industry. · Experience in predictive technologies, precision alignments, and general maintenance of applicable process equipment. · Understands electrical, mechanical, fluid power and control systems. Can analyze the problem, synthesize alternative solutions, and perform repairs. · Must be able to use basic hand tools and specialized tools as appropriate. · Experience in vibration analysis or laser interferometer operations, precision alignments, and maintenance of applicable process equipment. · May be required to travel. Physical Demands and Working Conditions: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands/fingers to handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb, ascend/descend or balance to heights that may require a ladder or lift; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl in confined spaces; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move more than 50 pounds. The employee is regularly required to use close vision and color vision. The employee is occasionally exposed to outside weather conditions and risk of electrical shock. Work is typically performed in a factory environment and is usually very loud. In the factory environment, the employee may be exposed to hazardous materials and/or greasy or slippery factory floors. ​ ATS believes in fair and equitable pay. Please not

beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:8f.title: Product Manager
beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:8f.description: Beacon https://beaconsoftware.com is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies — niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore. Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently — accelerating that growth with an AI-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable. We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better. Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game. ABOUT THE ROLE You'll be joining Beacon's Portfolio Product team, a cross-functional group of Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, GTM experts, and Data Scientists. We work directly with our 30+ portfolio companies, businesses we're acquiring at roughly one per week, to drive measurable outcomes through AI and software. As a Product Manager, you'll own product outcomes for 3-4 portfolio companies at a time. You'll sit close to the GM, the operators, and the customers, figuring out where the leverage is and shipping software directly into their business. The best PMs in this role won't just deliver for the companies they're deployed at. They'll compress what they learned into reusable playbooks that ship to every other portfolio company in the same vertical. This is not a consulting role. We ship software, not slides. The deliverable is a running system. Key Responsibilities - Own product outcomes for 3-4 portfolio companies simultaneously, acting as a fractional product leader embedded in each business - Lead quarterly and annual planning, helping teams set product visions and translate them into achievable goals - Build and maintain roadmaps that balance customer needs, business goals, and technical constraints - Drive sprint planning and execution, improving team velocity and predictability over time - Develop prioritization frameworks that help CEOs and operators make better product decisions - Build customer feedback systems that turn qualitative inputs into actionable roadmap decisions - Coordinate feature launches across engineering, sales, marketing, and support - Coach developers, designers, and early PMs to think like product managers - Distill learnings into cross-portfolio playbooks that scale impact beyond your assigned companies What We're Looking For - BA/BS Degree - 4+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS - Strong fundamentals: roadmapping, sprint planning, spec writing, prioritization frameworks - Sharp customer discovery instincts and ability to identify high-impact opportunities fast - Comfortable managing multiple companies and stakeholders simultaneously - Ability to influence founders and executives without direct authority - High autonomy, low ego. You figure things out and get them done - Entrepreneurial mindset and genuine comfort with ambiguity This role is perfect for you if... - You are an ex-founder or want to start your own B2B SaaS company one day - You want real exposure to how profitable businesses are built and scaled across multiple industries - You get more satisfaction from building capability in others than shipping features yoursel

beedie-beedie:lever:3d715c64-7ea3-4d27-9.title: Associate – Operations
beedie-beedie:lever:3d715c64-7ea3-4d27-9.description: Beedie Capital is a multi-strategy direct investment platform that manages the alternative investments and assets for Beedie, one of the most established private enterprises in Western Canada. We combine the strategic capabilities of an institutional investment platform with the flexibility and entrepreneurial mindset of a privately owned business, having successfully deployed over $1 billion in capital in the last 5 years. As the platform continues to scale, operational excellence and disciplined execution are critical to long-term performance. The Operations team plays a central role in building and maintaining the systems, processes, and infrastructure that support that growth. Position Overview This role sits at the center of the firm's operating infrastructure. You will manage our CRM environment day-to-day, maintain reporting discipline across the business, and execute the processes that support our investment, people, and go-to-market functions. The skillset mirrors what you would find in a strong revenue operations professional, but the scope is broader. You will operate across every function of the firm, not just sales. The work spans CRM operations, reporting, project execution, and cross-functional process management. You will drive clarity, accountability, and follow-through across multiple concurrent workstreams. This is a role for someone who finds satisfaction in keeping systems clean, data accurate, and processes running. You will be expected to leverage AI tools to improve how you work. We are actively building AI into the firm's operations, and this role will be on the front line of applying those tools day-to-day.
responsibilities: Sales & Marketing Ops
Operate HubSpot day-to-day: reporting, data hygiene, workflow automation, and pipeline tracking
Build and maintain dashboards that surface pipeline health, conversion metrics, and campaign performance
Keep marketing materials organized, accessible, and current across the team
Identify and flag manual workflows that could be automated to improve efficiency
Investment Ops
Operate HubSpot deal tracking on the investment side, ensuring clean data from sourcing through close
Manage project management workflows and task tracking for deal execution, process implementations, and cross-functional initiatives
Maintain SharePoint document structure, governance, and accessibility of key investment documents
Maintain data integrity across all operational systems (HubSpot, ClickUp, SharePoint)
Execute on new system implementations and process changes, driving timelines and stakeholder accountability
People Ops
Build and maintain a hiring database to support recruiting operations and candidate tracking
Develop and maintain a structured onboarding process
Reporting & Data
Generate monthly, quarterly, and annual reports on time and with consistent accuracy
Assemble final deliverables across all data sources, including Addepar outputs from other team members
Serve as the central data steward for the business — ensure data is clean, consistent, and reliable across all systems
Improve and promote routine data entry standards across the team
Use AI tools to accelerate report generation, data cleaning, and identification of inconsistencies across systems.
Ad Hoc & Operational Support
Provide operational follow-through on ad hoc initiatives, including task tracking, status updates, and accountability loops
Continuously improve how you execute within existing systems, including thoughtful use of AI tools where appropriate
qualifications: 3–5 years of experience in operations, strategy & operations, revenue operations, or a similarly analytical execution role
Strong CRM experience (HubSpot preferred), including workflow configuration and reporting
Demonstrated comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to improve speed and accuracy in operational work.
Proven experience improving funnel visibility, reporting, or forecasting processes
Track record of executing structured processes and driving accountability across teams
Strong analytical skills with a data-first approach to problem-solving
Experience managing projects using tools such as ClickUp, Asana, or similar
High attention to detail, ownership mindset, and comfort operating with sensitive information
Bias towards action, with a preference for executing and refining over waiting for perfect conditions
We thank all candidates for their interest but only those applicants selected for an interview will be contacted. No telephone calls or recruitment agencies will be accepted.

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:b4.title: HVAC Licensed Residential Technicians
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:b4.description: Job Duties Description The HVAC Technician is responsible for installing, repairing, and maintaining heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning systems in residential and light commercial settings. This role includes diagnosing HVAC issues, performing routine maintenance, ensuring code and manufacturer compliance, interacting professionally with clients, and completing jobs efficiently with minimal supervision. Our HVAC work consists of Residential (80%) / Commercial (20%) service, replacements, upgrades, renovations, system buildouts, and repairs. This position is ideal for a highly skilled technician who prefers diversity, responsibility, and independence in their workday. Because our work is people-oriented, this role requires strong communication and superior customer-service skills. The ideal candidate is experienced, punctual, safety-conscious, organized, and able to deliver high-quality workmanship while representing the company professionally. Key Responsibilities HVAC Work -- Plan layout, assemble, install, maintain, and test HVAC equipment and systems in residential and commercial settings. -- Install, maintain, and repair heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning systems including furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, boilers, ductwork, thermostats, and related controls. -- Perform system replacements, equipment upgrades, refrigerant charging, and airflow balancing as needed. -- Read and interpret blueprints, mechanical plans, wiring diagrams, and technical HVAC documentation. -- Ensure all work complies with state and local mechanical codes, HVAC manufacturer specifications, and industry best practices. -- Perform diagnostics using meters, gauges, and specialized HVAC tools; make necessary calculations to complete -- HVAC assignments (airflow, load, superheat/subcooling, etc.). -- Operate and maintain service truck, HVAC tools, gauges, meters, recovery machines, and other equipment. Customer Service and Operations Support -- Communicate and coordinate with colleagues and with customers about complete work and remaining regarding job scope, timelines, and costs. -- Complete service tickets and daily logs accurately and on time. -- Collect payment for services requested. -- Organize and prioritize work to meet project commitments. Prepare for upcoming jobs, including ensuring proper material is on hand when needed. -- Update industry knowledge and safety practices by participating in educational opportunities; reading technical publications, etc. -- Identify and suggest opportunities for additional services needed. -- Maintain a clean and safe work environment on all job sites Qualifications: -- Licensed HVAC Technician in Connecticut or equivalent state-required HVAC certifications (required). -- EPA 608 Certification (required). -- Minimum 5 years of residential and light commercial HVAC service experience. -- Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, mechanical codes, refrigeration principles, and safe work practices. -- Experience working with older HVAC systems, legacy equipment, and retrofit situations is highly desirable. -- Leadership or mentoring experience is preferred. -- Good writing and math skills, with strong attention to detail, submitting paperwork, service notes, and documentation to the office. -- Excellent communication skills when working with customers, team members, and office staff. -- Clean driving record and ability to pass background and drug testing. -- All applicants must show documentation of legal authorization to work in the U.S. -- Proficient with mobile work order apps, time tracking systems, and basic inventory management. Physical & Work Environment Requirements -- Ability to lift 50 lbs. and work on ladders up to 30 ft. -- Work performed in homes, businesses, and outdoor environments. -- Willingness to work occasional evenings/weekends for emergencies

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:736edfd8-.title: Senior Director, Social Media and Influencer Growth Marketing
gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:736edfd8-.description: About Gen Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We're always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate — leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you're part of Gen, you'll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career — from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You'll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we'd love you to be part of Gen. How We Work Our hybrid work model (3 days in the California or NY office) gives us the face-to-face time to have creative conversations, meaningful meetings, make quick decisions, and build relationships. At the same time, it offers flexibility you need to focus and do your best work. About the Role Job Title: Senior Director, Social Media and Influencer Growth Marketing Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer Location: Mountain View California or New York Office Hybrid (3 days office) We believe social is one of the clearest paths to winning as a business, and this role requires the strategic range to prove that out: building the fully integrated social ecosystem that turns social into one of the biggest levers Gen has right now. The same shift “mobile-first” forced a decade ago is the model. Mobile-first never meant “have an app,” it meant every product decision ran through a mobile lens first. Social-first means the same discipline applied to marketing: social stops being a channel we staff and becomes a lens the entire business thinks through, from how a launch is planned to what campaigns get built. Social-first thinking is where Gen builds brand authority, drives customer acquisition, and compounds growth. This is the strategic architect who owns that transformation end to end: the strategy, the team, and the operating model. You report directly to the CMO, sit at the center of Global Marketing's leadership network, and are accountable for social and influencer growth performance across several of Gen’s consumer brands including Norton, LifeLock, and Avast. Success is measured in business terms: social's contribution to brand relevance, social performance, and growth. About the Team You'll join the Marketing Leadership Team, working alongside peers who lead brand and growth, media and performance marketing, GenStudio (our in-house creative studio), communications and corporate marketing, partner marketing, and AI transformation. Together, we drive integrated marketing acquisition and brand building across Gen's portfolio. You'll own social and influencer/creator strategy end to end. You'll lead, develop, and scale our social team and the function as it grows. This is your chance to build out the social and influencer capability from the ground up, creating the operating model that makes social a critical part of Gen's direct to consumer growth engine. Key Responsibilities - Own the social-first transformation agenda: build the strategy, business case, and operating model that shift Gen's consumer brands from treating social as a channel to treating it as the lens the business plans th

Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. About the Role: The Senior Financial Analyst is an important individual contributor role within MoneyLion’s Analytics & Decisioning team. This person will own specific reports, analyses, and data pipelines that support financial decision-making across accounting, forecasting, and customer economics. Working with moderate supervision, this role is expected to deliver high-quality, independently produced analytical work and begin to develop direct relationships with key stakeholders. This role sits at the intersection of financial analysis and data engineering, partnering with Finance, Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams. The ideal candidate has strong SQL skills and financial acumen, can run analyses end-to-end with limited direction, and is developing the business and product intuition to identify the right questions to ask. Key Responsibilities: - Own and maintain specific financial reporting workstreams, including recurring dashboards and analyses that support accounting and FP&A teams - Document and communicate the business logic underlying assigned financial models, ensuring accuracy and traceability for downstream stakeholders - Support the translation of accounting principles into SQL and dbt models, with guidance from senior team members on more complex business rules - Partner with the Accounting and FP&A teams on period-close deliverables and ad hoc data requests - Contribute to the CLR/LTV measurement framework by building and maintaining cohort-level analyses across customer segments, products, and acquisition channels - Produce regular reporting on customer health metrics with clear interpretation and suggested next steps - Build and maintain reports that track MoneyLion Membership program economics, including member engagement, product attach rates, and incremental revenue metrics - Support the maintenance and monitoring of forward flow pricing models - Write well-structured, documented SQL and dbt models that encode financial business logic - Develop Python-based analytical workflows for financial modeling and scenario analysis tasks About you: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field required. Experience: 3+ years of experience in financial analysis, FP&A, or quantitative analytics, ideally within a fintech, consumer lending, or financial services environment. Skills: - Strong SQL skills for querying and transforming large financial datasets; experience with dbt is a plus - Proficiency or growing proficiency in Python for financial modeling and data manipulation (pandas, numpy)

jobandtalent-jobandtalent:lever:66488e15.description: Join us to shape the future of work: your next adventure awaits! The Position We are seeking a hands-on Accountant to join our U.S. Controlling & Accounting team. This position is fully remote, with the employee expected to work primarily from their remote location (from Madrid, Sevilla, or Barcelona). The role will require periodic in-person attendance at our Madrid, Spain headquarters, generally on a monthly basis, to collaborate with the broader Controlling & Accounting team, particularly during key month-end close periods. The frequency and timing of office attendance will be communicated in advance based on business needs and close-cycle requirements. The Accountant will support day-to-day accounting operations and help ensure the accuracy, timeliness, and efficiency of key financial processes. The role will be actively involved in month-end close, account reconciliations, journal entries, financial reporting, audit preparation, and continuous improvement of accounting processes.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:14870bd8-e651-.title: Senior Technical Recruiter (Product & Design Engineering)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:14870bd8-e651-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Recruiter (Technical & Engineering) based in United States. This is an opportunity to lead full-cycle recruiting for highly specialized Technical and Engineering teams within a rapidly scaling AI infrastructure organization. You will work directly with hiring managers and leadership to define talent needs, build targeted recruiting strategies, and identify exceptional candidates. The role combines strategic partnership with hands-on sourcing, outreach, interviewing, and closing. You’ll operate in a fast-moving environment where priorities can shift quickly and recruiting needs evolve continuously. Your work will directly influence the teams being built and the organization’s ability to scale. Success in this role requires urgency, sound judgment, creativity, and a consistently high bar for talent and candidate experience. Lead full-cycle recruiting for Technical and Engineering positions, managing sourcing, outreach, interviews, feedback coordination, and offer closing. Partner closely with hiring managers and senior leaders to understand workforce needs, clarify requirements, and develop focused recruiting strategies. Create clear, compelling job descriptions and talent messaging designed to attract highly qualified technical professionals. Develop creative sourcing strategies for passive candidates through technical communities, professional networks, industry channels, and data-driven search techniques. Deliver a responsive, professional, and high-quality candidate experience throughout the recruitment process. Effectively communicate the organization’s mission, culture, opportunities, and working environment to prospective candidates. Maintain accurate candidate pipelines, recruiting activity, and hiring metrics within Greenhouse or comparable ATS platforms. Analyze recruiting data to identify opportunities to improve sourcing effectiveness, hiring speed, candidate quality, and overall process efficiency. Identify recruiting process gaps and implement practical improvements as the organization continues to scale. Operate with strong ownership by raising risks early, communicating directly, documenting decisions, and adapting recruiting strategies as priorities change. Requirements 5+ years of experience recruiting for Technical and Engineering roles, ideally within fast-paced, high-growth organizations. Demonstrated strength in sourcing and engaging passive technical talent through creative and targeted recruiting approaches. Strong understanding of technical recruiting practices and the ability to evaluate talent against specialized role requirements. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:96c5eb55-c07.title: Non-Linguistic Quality Control Specialists (US)
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:96c5eb55-c07.description: Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. We are expanding its non-Linguistic Quality Control (QC) team to support some of the world's leading pharmaceutical and CRO clients, and we're looking for detail-obsessed QC specialists who take real pride in catching what others miss.If you love the precision of quality control and want your work to matter in an industry where accuracy genuinely impacts patient safety, this is your opportunity to join a high-visibility program with steady, daily volume and long-term growth potential. What you'll do Perform Quality Control of translations into English for pharmacovigilance, regulatory, and clinical content. Ideal candidate brings experience with clinical/regulatory documents (medical reports, protocols, synopses, ICF, discharge and study reports, SmPC, PIL, medical literature, linguistic validation) or pharmacovigilance documents (SAE/AE, PSURs, SUSARs, ICSRs, DSUR, RMP) Use CAT tools (XTM preferred) and run QC checks to ensure accuracy and consistency. Validate formatting, numbers, dates, units, terminology, and adherence to instructions. Support processing of non-editable/handwritten sources and perform formatting QC after conversion. Self-assign work according to availability via Open Offers and meet urgent TATs (typically 12–24 hours). Handle high volume split across multiple small files; document and report discrepancies. Cross-collaboration with PMs and escalate risks promptly. Requirements Mandatory experience with CAT tools: XTM, Trados, MemoQ, Phrase or others. Experience with QA checks: Xbench, Verifika, or CAT-integrated QA. Experience with Track Changes function in Word. Minimum 6 months as a Language QA specialist in localization. Advanced English level, min. C1 Availability of 4–5 hours per day; willing to work weekends and bank holidays. Able to meet urgent TATs (12–24 hours) and manage many small files. Willing to complete the QC test and follow staged onboarding. Prior experience with a similar QC role at an LSP is a strong plus. Nice to have Flexibility and willingness to work occasional weekends and bank holidays.
